Source format: public notice

The line will be closed to all rail traffic from 23:59 hours on Friday 14 August 2026 until 05:00
hours on Monday 17 August 2026. This closure window has been selected to avoid interference with
weekday commuter services and to allow works to be completed over a continuous weekend period.
The department notes that this closure does not coincide with any gazetted public holiday in the
affected local government areas.

During the closure period, the following works will be undertaken:

- Replacement of approximately 1,850 metres of continuously welded rail between track markers
  KM 12.400 and KM 14.250.
- Re-sleepering of 1,200 sleepers on the down line between Portsea Junction and Newhaven.
- Repairs to culvert drainage at three identified locations, including replacement of a
  failed 900 mm diameter concrete pipe near track marker KM 8.100.
- Upgrade of the level crossing warning system at the Dandenong Creek Road crossing,
  including installation of new LED signals and boom barrier mechanisms.
- Reconditioning of the signalling control system at Newhaven Station, including software
  updates and replacement of trackside signal heads.

No passenger or freight services will operate on the Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line during the
closure window. Replacement bus services will be provided for passengers affected by the
closure. Full details of replacement bus timetables will be published by the relevant train
operator no later than 31 July 2026.

Freight operators who require access to the line during the closure window are advised to
contact the Department of Transport and Planning’s Rail Network Services Division to discuss
alternative arrangements or to register for track access notifications. The department
understands that freight movements are time-sensitive and will consider urgent access requests
on a case-by-case basis, provided that safety conditions can be met.

Community Information Sessions

The department will host two community information sessions to provide further details about
the maintenance works and to answer questions from residents and businesses. The sessions will
be held at the following locations:

# TRANSPORT AND PLANNING ACT 1985
## NOTICE OF TEMPORARY LINE CLOSURE FOR PLANNED MAINTENANCE

**Reference No:** DTP/RN/2026/1147
**Date of Issue:** 12 July 2026

---

### SUMMARY OF CLOSURE ARRANGEMENTS

This notice confirms the planned maintenance closure of the Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line and provides a consolidated summary of the arrangements previously advised. All details contained in this notice take effect from the dates specified and remain in force until the line is reopened to passenger services.

**Closure Period:**

The line will be closed to all rail traffic from **23:59 hours on Friday 14 August 2026** until **05:00 hours on Monday 17 August 2026**.

**Reason for Closure:**

Essential track maintenance, including rail replacement works between Rye and Sorrento, drainage improvements at multiple locations, and overhead structure inspections. These works cannot be safely undertaken while trains are operating and have been scheduled for the weekend period to minimise disruption to passengers and the community.

**Affected Line Section:**

Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line, being the rail corridor between Newhaven Station (inclusive) and Portsea Station (inclusive).

---

### KEY DATES AND TIMETABLE

| Date | Event |
|------|-------|
| 12 July 2026 | This notice issued |
| 27 July 2026 | Final confirmation of bus replacement timetable published |
| 14 August 2026 | Last through services operate (normal weekday timetable) |
| 14 August 2026, 23:59 | Line closure commences |
| 15–16 August 2026 | Maintenance works undertaken; replacement buses operate |
| 17 August 2026, 05:00 | Line reopens; normal services resume from first train |

**Note:** The line closure includes the entire weekend of 15–16 August 2026. There will be no rail services in either direction during this period.

---

### REPLACEMENT BUS SERVICES

A replacement bus service will operate throughout the closure period, connecting all stations on the affected line section. The bus timetable will be published on the project website and distributed at stations from **27 July 2026**.

**Bus Service Details:**

- Buses will run at regular intervals from approximately 06:00 to 23:00 on both days of the closure.
- All regular stopping patterns will be maintained, with buses calling at each station on the line.
- Additional express services will operate between Newhaven and Portsea during peak travel times on Saturday morning and Sunday evening.
- The replacement service is wheelchair accessible, and boarding ramps are available at all affected stations. Companion card holders travel free on the replacement service.

**Transfer Arrangements:**

Passengers transferring between rail and bus services should allow an additional 20 minutes for their journey. Buses will depart from designated stops adjacent to each station. Station staff will be available to assist passengers with connections.

---

### STATION ACCESS AND FACILITIES

During the closure period, station car parks will remain open and accessible to the public. Ticket vending machines will remain operational, and station waiting areas will be open during daylight hours. Toilets at staffed stations will be available during advertised station opening times.

**Bicycle Access:**

Bicycles will not be carried on replacement buses due to space limitations. Secure bicycle parking is available at all stations, and passengers are encouraged to use these facilities where possible. A temporary bicycle parking compound will be provided at Rye Station for the duration of the closure.

documents.content:
The line will be closed to all rail traffic from 23:59 hours on Friday 14 August 2026 until 05:00
hours on Monday 17 August 2026. This closure window has been selected to avoid interference with
weekday commuter services and to allow works to be completed over a continuous weekend period.
The department notes that this closure does not coincide with any gazetted public holiday in the
affected local government areas.

During the closure period, the following works will be undertaken:

- Replacement of approximately 1,850 metres of continuously welded rail between track markers
  KM 12.400 and KM 14.250.
- Re-sleepering of 1,200 sleepers on the down line between Portsea Junction and Newhaven.
- Repairs to culvert drainage at three identified locations, including replacement of a
  failed 900 mm diameter concrete pipe near track marker KM 8.100.
- Upgrade of the level crossing warning system at the Dandenong Creek Road crossing,
  including installation of new LED signals and boom barrier mechanisms.
- Reconditioning of the signalling control system at Newhaven Station, including software
  updates and replacement of trackside signal heads.

No passenger or freight services will operate on the Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line during the
closure window. Replacement bus services will be provided for passengers affected by the
closure. Full details of replacement bus timetables will be published by the relevant train
operator no later than 31 July 2026.

Freight operators who require access to the line during the closure window are advised to
contact the Department of Transport and Planning’s Rail Network Services Division to discuss
alternative arrangements or to register for track access notifications. The department
understands that freight movements are time-sensitive and will consider urgent access requests
on a case-by-case basis, provided that safety conditions can be met.

Community Information Sessions

The department will host two community information sessions to provide further details about
the maintenance works and to answer questions from residents and businesses. The sessions will
be held at the following locations:

# TRANSPORT AND PLANNING ACT 1985
## NOTICE OF TEMPORARY LINE CLOSURE FOR PLANNED MAINTENANCE

**Reference No:** DTP/RN/2026/1147
**Date of Issue:** 12 July 2026

---

### SUMMARY OF CLOSURE ARRANGEMENTS

This notice confirms the planned maintenance closure of the Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line and provides a consolidated summary of the arrangements previously advised. All details contained in this notice take effect from the dates specified and remain in force until the line is reopened to passenger services.

**Closure Period:**

The line will be closed to all rail traffic from **23:59 hours on Friday 14 August 2026** until **05:00 hours on Monday 17 August 2026**.

**Reason for Closure:**

Essential track maintenance, including rail replacement works between Rye and Sorrento, drainage improvements at multiple locations, and overhead structure inspections. These works cannot be safely undertaken while trains are operating and have been scheduled for the weekend period to minimise disruption to passengers and the community.

**Affected Line Section:**

Newhaven–Portsea Regional Line, being the rail corridor between Newhaven Station (inclusive) and Portsea Station (inclusive).

---

### KEY DATES AND TIMETABLE

| Date | Event |
|------|-------|
| 12 July 2026 | This notice issued |
| 27 July 2026 | Final confirmation of bus replacement timetable published |
| 14 August 2026 | Last through services operate (normal weekday timetable) |
| 14 August 2026, 23:59 | Line closure commences |
| 15–16 August 2026 | Maintenance works undertaken; replacement buses operate |
| 17 August 2026, 05:00 | Line reopens; normal services resume from first train |

**Note:** The line closure includes the entire weekend of 15–16 August 2026. There will be no rail services in either direction during this period.

---

### REPLACEMENT BUS SERVICES

A replacement bus service will operate throughout the closure period, connecting all stations on the affected line section. The bus timetable will be published on the project website and distributed at stations from **27 July 2026**.

**Bus Service Details:**

- Buses will run at regular intervals from approximately 06:00 to 23:00 on both days of the closure.
- All regular stopping patterns will be maintained, with buses calling at each station on the line.
- Additional express services will operate between Newhaven and Portsea during peak travel times on Saturday morning and Sunday evening.
- The replacement service is wheelchair accessible, and boarding ramps are available at all affected stations. Companion card holders travel free on the replacement service.

**Transfer Arrangements:**

Passengers transferring between rail and bus services should allow an additional 20 minutes for their journey. Buses will depart from designated stops adjacent to each station. Station staff will be available to assist passengers with connections.

---

### STATION ACCESS AND FACILITIES

During the closure period, station car parks will remain open and accessible to the public. Ticket vending machines will remain operational, and station waiting areas will be open during daylight hours. Toilets at staffed stations will be available during advertised station opening times.

**Bicycle Access:**

Bicycles will not be carried on replacement buses due to space limitations. Secure bicycle parking is available at all stations, and passengers are encouraged to use these facilities where possible. A temporary bicycle parking compound will be provided at Rye Station for the duration of the closure.

"Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday) on which banks are open for general banking business in Melbourne, Victoria.

"Contract Price" means the total amount payable to the Contractor for the performance of the Services, as calculated in accordance with Schedule 2.

"Defect" means any failure of an asset to comply with the Maintenance Standards.

"Maintenance Standards" means the standards, specifications, and guidelines set out in Schedule 3, as amended from time to time by the Authority in accordance with clause 9.

"Network" means the rail infrastructure assets owned or managed by the Authority and identified in Schedule 1.

"Services" means the maintenance services described in Schedule 1, including routine inspections, corrective maintenance, and emergency response.

"Site" means any location on the Network where the Services are performed.

"Track Possession" means a period during which the Contractor has exclusive access to a defined section of track for the purpose of performing the Services.

2.1 The Authority engages the Contractor to perform the Services, and the Contractor accepts the engagement, on the terms and conditions of this Contract.

2.2 The Services comprise the following categories of maintenance work:

(a) Routine maintenance: scheduled inspections, lubrication, vegetation control, and minor repairs as set out in the maintenance schedule at Schedule 1, Part A.

(b) Corrective maintenance: repair or replacement of defective assets identified during inspections or reported by the Authority or third parties, as set out in Schedule 1, Part B.
